// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1443): images under other names, none with accessibilityIgnoresInvertColors.
// The scan finds them by import source, not by tag name. Fictional family only.
import { Image as Pic, ImageBackground } from 'react-native';
import { Image as ExpoPic } from 'expo-image';
import FastImage from 'react-native-fast-image';
import { Image } from 'react-native';
const Snap = Image;
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Pic source={{ uri }} />
      <ExpoPic source={uri} />
      <FastImage source={{ uri }} />
      <Snap source={{ uri }} />
      <ImageBackground source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
